statement: Stage agents apply the exact canonical QRSPI contract through a generated hash-bound bundled reference
Only confirmed current Workflowd publication may advance a QRSPI stage or generation
description: A producer result is candidate content, not authority to publish it or release dependent work.

statement: QRSPI retries and restarts from bounded immutable ticket and predecessor authority without mutable rediscovery
description: The stored request must carry enough exact identity and content to reproduce the same trusted task after a crash.

statement: Workflow start creates one current generation only from ready product intent and an exact review target
description: Branch creation and durable work must remain idempotent, currentness-fenced, and recoverable across uncertain provider outcomes.

statement: QRSPI executes each stage through the exact trusted contract selected by its persisted identity
description: Type erasure may hide contract types from the scheduler, but it must not weaken registration identity, compatibility, or dispatch authority.
